item.title: Custom Heart-Shaped Rigid Gift Box with Magnetic Closure and Velvet Interior
item.description:
Product Overview

Our custom heart-shaped rigid gift box combines romantic design with premium craftsmanship. The distinctive heart silhouette is constructed from 2.5mm rigid greyboard, wrapped in luxurious art paper with a plush velvet-flocked interior. A discreet magnetic closure keeps contents secure while the satin ribbon adds an elegant opening experience. Manufactured on our Heidelberg 7+1 UV press with precision die-cutting for consistent heart contours — ideal for Valentine’s Day, wedding proposals, anniversary gifts, and luxury jewelry presentation.

item.title: Fully Custom Printed Triangular Gift Box for Holiday Gifting
item.description:
Premium custom fully custom printed triangular gift box for holiday gifting manufactured by Guangdong Bincai Color Printing Co., Ltd. — a Diamond Member on Made-in-China.com since 2015, Audited Supplier with 22 years of experience.

Applications

  • Holiday & Seasonal Gifting: Christmas, Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, and Lunar New Year gift packaging — the unique triangular shape creates instant visual impact on retail shelves
  • Chocolate & Confectionery: Premium chocolate boxes with die-cut foam or cardboard inserts for truffles, pralines, and artisanal sweets
  • Jewelry & Accessories: Luxury presentation for necklaces, bracelets, watches, and designer accessories with velvet or satin interior
  • Candle & Home Fragrance: Distinctive packaging for scented candles, diffuser sets, and aromatherapy collections
  • Corporate Gifts: Branded gift boxes for employee recognition, client appreciation, and promotional events with custom logo embossing
  • Wedding Favors: Elegant packaging for wedding favors, bridesmaid gifts, and ceremony keepsakes

Customization Options

  • Shape & Structure: Equilateral triangle (60°), isosceles, or custom angular designs — rigid greyboard construction with precision die-cut corners
  • Opening Mechanism: Magnetic flap closure, telescopic two-piece lid-and-base, ribbon tie, or book-style hinge with satin pull ribbon
  • Exterior Surface: Art paper wrap in metallic, matte, textured, soft-touch, or pearlescent finishes — full Pantone color matching
  • Printing & Decoration: CMYK offset on KBA 1050 4-color press; hot foil stamping (gold, silver, rose gold, holographic); embossing/debossing; spot UV varnish; matte or gloss lamination
  • Interior Lining: Velvet flocking (100+ Pantone colors), satin fabric, suede, or premium art paper — complete interior coverage
  • Insert Options: Custom die-cut EVA foam, flocked vacuum-formed tray, cardboard grid dividers, or satin pillow inserts
  • Size Range: From 80mm edge-length mini boxes to 350mm edge-length large format — fully custom dimensions

Production Specifications

  • Press: KBA 1050 4-color offset press with inline aqueous coating for exterior art paper printing
  • Heidelberg 7+1 UV: Premium spot UV accents, high-gloss coatings, and specialty ink effects
  • Die-Cutting: Precision CNC die-making with ±0.1mm tolerance for angular geometric shapes
  • Rigid Box Line: Fully automatic rigid box production line with corner wrapping, inner liner mounting, and magnet insertion
  • Greyboard Core: 1200gsm–2000gsm greyboard for structural rigidity — wrap-laminated in single pass
  • Surface Wrapping: 157gsm–250gsm art paper, metallic paper, or specialty textured stock
  • Magnets: N35–N52 grade neodymium magnets, 6mm–10mm diameter, 2–4 magnets per box

Production Quality & Testing

  • Color Accuracy: Heidelberg Prinect Inpress closed-loop spectrophotometry — ΔE ≤ 2.0 across full production
  • Die-Cut Precision: Angular tolerance ±0.1mm for clean geometric edges and seamless corner joins
  • Magnet Testing: Pull-force verification at 3.5–5.5N per magnet pair; 500+ open/close cycle testing
  • Corner Durability: Drop test from 0.8m — greyboard corners maintain structural integrity
  • Surface Testing: Rub-fastness to ISO 105-X12 for foil stamping and printed surfaces
  • ISO 9001:2015: Full quality management system — incoming material inspection, in-process QC, final audit
  • FSC Certified: Chain-of-custody certified materials from sustainably managed forests
  • 100% Visual Inspection: Under D50 standard lighting (ISO 3664:2009) for consistent color evaluation
